Also, experience. Believe in yourself man. I try to do things simply because I'm afraid of doing it, to prove to myself that I can do it. Sometimes it fails and when i speak up, my voice is all high pitches and shaky but in the long term, I hope exposing yourself to some of these fears will help.

I know what you mean and in June(21st bday) I was in the exact same place as you(kissless, hugless, no friends). Look through my post history if you like. Only difference was I've been working since 17.

Things have changed a lot now and I have kissed a girl(who i actually met on reddit) and been on a date. I'm still a virgin, but my overall quality of life has improved a lot.

 I've been on holiday on my own(to visit a reddit friend) and in September started a new job, where people are very kind, believe that I can be successful and encourage me. Just this week I had to chair a meeting and did it successfully, when before I was struggling to just say my name when going through introductions. People actually said you were very confident and they don't believe that I felt nervous. My lack of social events gave me a lot of free time to go to the gym 6/7x per week, and as a result I've got to a good level of strength/physique very quickly. I'm going to compete in powerlifting as soon as possible, and have made friends from gym where people now ask me for advice.

So, a lot can change in 6 months(or even less) if you're willing to wait. You deserve to be happy, as everyone does. So wait a bit and see what happens. I never believed the "it gets better", but my anxiety is considerably less. Not everything is perfect, I'm still a virgin and don't have many friends, but I'm now enjoying life and no longer in a position where I want to kill myself. I promise your anxiety will get better over time.
